title: Three-Object Glance · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three-Object Glance · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place three ordinary objects on a table and let everyone look briefly, then cover them. The lead names the three objects from memory. All three named objects match the display. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three household objects and a cloth.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three-Object Glance, what counts as a successful turn?
options: All three named objects match the display.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: All three named objects match the display.

game.materials: Three household objects and a cloth
